page.layout: One printed page: running head at top (page number left, "EMBLEMA" centred above the title), a large engraving in the middle, verse epigram below the engraving, a catchword-like word at the lower right margin.

main_text.head: SIMPLICITAS CORONATVR
main_text.p: [engraving: an angel or winged figure reaching down from clouds to a woman with a halo, holding a crown; below, a donkey carrying a bird on a staff, standing on open books]
main_text.l: Verbum namq; tibi pedibusq; Lucerna tuis est,
Et fax. Non errat qui hoc duce carpit iter.

page.notes: The engraving is a framed plate with a woman in clouds receiving a crown, and a donkey with a bird on its back standing on two open books; the donkey scene is described, not transcribed. The Greek word Λόγος is printed in the second verse line. The word "Miræ" at lower right is a catchword. The page number "14" is printed at the upper left and the running head "EMBLEMA" is centred above the title.
